data.body: SETUP AND CONSTRAINTS. Standalone study at /Users/joeoakhart/plan-review-bakeoff, its own git repo (~60 commits), deliberately independent of the rebar ticket system. Compares 4 plan-review sources on identical plans. NO new rebar plan reviews were run at any point: rebar's arm is extracted from existing signed REVIEW_RESULT sidecars. Arms are the real tools, not distilled prompts: rebar sidecars; Compound Engineering ce-doc-review 3.24.0 (persona fan-out, real subagents); superpowers 6.3.0 writing-plans + plan-document-reviewer-prompt; mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 real CLI in an isolated venv on anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. Skills load via ~/.claude/skills/ symlinks because plugin-path skills do not resolve on this box. Work is organised into three waves, defined in WAVES.md.
